arguments.sql:
WITH last_rounds AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(round) AS round
    FROM main.races
    WHERE year IN (1988, 2007)
    GROUP BY year
),
comparison AS (
    SELECT r.year, 'driver standings' AS source, s.driver_id AS entity_id, s.points
    FROM last_rounds AS l
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.year = l.year AND r.round = l.round
    JOIN main.driver_standings AS s ON s.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year = 1988
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.year, 'driver results', s.driver_id, SUM(s.points)
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS s ON s.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year = 1988
    GROUP BY r.year, s.driver_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.year, 'constructor standings', s.constructor_id, s.points
    FROM last_rounds AS l
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.year = l.year AND r.round = l.round
    JOIN main.constructor_standings AS s ON s.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year = 2007
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.year, 'constructor results', s.constructor_id, SUM(s.points)
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.constructor_results AS s ON s.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year = 2007
    GROUP BY r.year, s.constructor_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year, source ORDER BY points DESC) AS point_rank
    FROM comparison
)
SELECT p.year, p.source, COALESCE(d.full_name, c.name) AS entity_name, p.points
FROM ranked AS p
LEFT JOIN main.drivers_ext AS d ON p.year = 1988 AND d.driver_id = p.entity_id
LEFT JOIN main.constructors AS c ON p.year = 2007 AND c.constructor_id = p.entity_id
WHERE p.point_rank = 1
ORDER BY p.year, p.source

item.text: Should I rank drivers and constructors by points in the final standings or by total points scored across races and sprints? The choice changes the answer. In 1988, Ayrton Senna led the final standings with 90 points, while Alain Prost scored 105 across races.
